metadata.case_name: LUNG SIU WING v. LO WAI MING AND OTHERS

plaintiff.education_level: studied up to the second year in secondary school in China

injuries.description: 4 cm laceration over his right lower back / back contusion
source: the plaintiff suffered from a 4 cm laceration over his right lower back, bruised and tenderness over his left forearm and fracture over his right 4th metatarsal bone on his right foot.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: Bruised and tenderness over his left forearm
source: the plaintiff suffered from a 4 cm laceration over his right lower back, bruised and tenderness over his left forearm and fracture over his right 4th metatarsal bone on his right foot.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified parts of forearm

injuries.description: Fracture of the right 4th metatarsal bone
source: the plaintiff suffered from a 4 cm laceration over his right lower back, bruised and tenderness over his left forearm and fracture over his right 4th metatarsal bone on his right foot.

manifestations.description: 4 to 5 cm laceration was found over the right lower back
cramps in his right foot every two to three days
right back soreness and discomfort after sitting for two to three hours
bruised and tenderness over his left forearm
had to walk with the aid of two crutches until the cast was removed 2 months later
difficulty in balancing on the ladder when exerting body weight on right foot
residual right foot pain and residual right back pain and scar

treatments_received: use of two crutches for walking until cast removed (2 months)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: loss of enjoyment of his sporting activities
residual scar on right lower back
reduced work efficiency and capacity; loss of earning capacity; likely suitable only for light duties
